writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: live runtime, Task Scheduler, network, external model or public state

observedContradictions.cause: _Stage hashes {'stage':stage_id,'payload':payload} but ExecutionController contract and S2 oracle hash {'stage':stage_id,'input':input_payload}
observedContradictions.correction: change only the S6 _Stage helper hash key payload to input

observedContradictions.cause: natural receipts and generated daily lineages are Scheduled,Audit,Public,Readiness but fixture history.requiredLineages and helper missing map use Recovery instead of Audit
observedContradictions.correction: change fixture history.requiredLineages and helper daily missing key Recovery to Audit; do not change recovery production semantics

observedContradictions.cause: missing_layer_hash pops layerEvidenceSha256 and then _reseal_admission restores it, yielding a value identical to positive
observedContradictions.correction: after recursive reseal remove layerEvidenceSha256 again and recompute only admissionSha256 so the negative has valid outer sealing but the required inner aggregate is absent

observedContradictions.cause: Public NOT_REQUIRED positive reseals the top receipt but leaves history daily Public receipt/provenance hashes tied to the former GREEN receipt
observedContradictions.correction: for that positive setup only, rebuild historyCoverage with _history_coverage(cases, receipts) before _reseal_natural; do not globally rebuild history in negative mutations

retention.rule: retain import-first release boundary, all sealed negative sets, actual L3-L7 calls and exact six nodes; no weakened assertion, skip, xfail or broad exception

expectedRedAfterCorrection.cause: tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_dispatch has no CLI/fault boundary, so --fault-after-initial-wal returns exit 0
expectedRedAfterCorrection.meaning: production dispatch CLI implementation required; not permission to weaken the fault assertion

verification.red: $env:NEWS_GRASP_HIGH_COST_BINDING_PATH=[Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('%USERPROFILE%\bin\news-grasp-high-cost-binding-v1.json'); py -3.12 -m pytest --noconftest -q tests/test_news_grasp_cleanroom_s6_release.py; expect exact 5 pass/1 dispatch CLI failure
verification.json: fixture parses and exact requiredLineages is Scheduled,Audit,Public,Readiness
verification.diff: git diff --check and exact two owned paths only

causalRetry: one authoring attempt and one causal correction only; unexpected failure returns to Sol without production edits
delivery: two hashes/bytes, exact six collection and 5/1 Red evidence, commit and clean status
stopPolicy: return to Sol; do not implement dispatch CLI
